note: Scout RFP, strategic sourcing; Workday acquired it in 2019 for $540M. Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2017 (firm's own page).
Scribe Therapeutics, engineered CRISPR molecules; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2021 (firm's own page).
Semgrep, application security scanning; Menlo led the Series D (the site dates the close 2024, the announcement is Feb 2025 — the close-year rule of decisions.md R1).
Senti Biosciences (SNTI, Nasdaq), synthetic gene circuits for cell therapy; listed by SPAC in 2022. Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2018 (firm's own page) and still held it in the 2026 13F.
SEPATON, virtual tape libraries; Hitachi Data Systems acquired it in 2014. First listed 2004, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy — the band's 'Seed' rides a 2013 $2M filing nine years later.
SessionM, customer engagement and loyalty; Mastercard acquired it in 2019. A REST-only listing with no milestone; entry round not established.
Shazam, music recognition; Apple acquired it in 2018 for ~$400M, which retires the standalone mark despite the former-unicorn flag. Form D 2015 $50M with Matt Murphy — a growth entry at scale.
ShipBob, e-commerce fulfilment; Menlo partnered at the Series C in 2018 (firm's own page). Last primary $1B (2021 Series E).

Shopkick, shopping rewards app; SK Telecom acquired it in 2014 for $200M and Trax bought it on in 2019. Form D 2010 $15.0M with Matt Murphy — a Kleiner-era name on a Menlo-listed row, corroborated by the firm's own listing.
ShopMy, creator commerce; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2025 (firm's own page and its own announcement post).
Sidecar Health, price-transparent health insurance; Menlo partnered at the Series C in 2021 (firm's own page).
Signifyd, guaranteed fraud protection for e-commerce; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2016 (firm's own page). Last primary $1.34B (2021 Series E).
SimpliVity, hyperconverged infrastructure; HPE acquired it in 2017 for $650M — below its $1B+ private mark, which the acquisition retires. Form D 2013-2015 to $175M with Matt Murphy.
Siri, the SRI spin-out; Apple acquired it in April 2010. Menlo and Morgenthaler led the $8.5M first round in Oct 2008 (the firm's own page marks it Series A 2008).
Siteline, construction subcontractor billing; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2021 (firm's own page).
Skeema, browser tab and task management; Form D 2023-2025 with Greg Rudin. Not on the portfolio listing — a live seed position the CMS has not published.
Skild AI, general-purpose robot foundation models; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2024 (firm's own page).
Slash, business banking for niche verticals; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2022 (firm's own page).
Sleuth, deployment and engineering-efficiency tracking; acquired in 2025. Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2022 (firm's own page).
Slingshot AI, foundation model for psychology (Ash); Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2024 (firm's own page).

Smartsheet (SMAR, NYSE), collaborative work management; IPO 2018, Blackstone and Vista took it private in 2025 for $8.4B, which retires the standalone mark. A REST-only historical listing with no milestone; entry round not established and probably pre-window.
Socialcast, enterprise social networking; VMware acquired it in 2011. Form D 2010 $8.0M with Sonja Perkins.
Soha Systems, cloud application access; Akamai acquired it in 2016. Listed 2015 with no milestone; entry round not established.

Solace Health, Medicare patient advocacy; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2025 (firm's own page and its own announcement post). Distinct from Solace Systems, the Canadian messaging-middleware company.
Sonrai Security, cloud identity and data governance; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2020 (firm's own page); the band read Series A off the same year's filing.

SpectraLink, wireless workplace telephones; NASDAQ IPO 1996, Polycom acquired it in 2007 and Sun Capital bought it on in 2012. Recovered from the LOGO-ONLY row on the 1998 communications page and corroborated by a Menlo fund 13G. Pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
SpeedDate, online dating; acquired by Snap Interactive in 2013. Form D 2011 $3.0M with Mark Siegel.
Spinnaker Networks, clustered NAS; Network Appliance acquired it in 2004 for $300M. A 1999-2000 Menlo position, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
Squad Health, a 2026 REST-only listing with no description or milestone. Entry round not established.

Squint, manufacturing intelligence; incubated inside Menlo Labs, and the firm's own Milestones mark the entry Pre-Seed 2022 — the 2023 post announcing a Sequoia-led seed is the company emerging, not the entry. The band read Seed off the 2023 $3.5M filing.
StackRox, Kubernetes-native security; Red Hat acquired it in 2021. Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2020 (firm's own page).
Stance, the sock and apparel brand; still trading. Form D 2015-2016 to $61.3M with Pravin Vazirani — a growth entry.
Sticky Technologies, a 2021-vintage seed position; Form D 2022 $3.6M with Greg Rudin and Shawn Carolan. No live surface and no listing since; recorded defunct at medium confidence.
Strata Identity, identity orchestration; Rubrik acquired it in 2026. Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2020 (firm's own page).
StrataCom, ATM and frame-relay WAN switching; Cisco acquired it in 1996 for $4.67B — one of the firm's largest early exits. A 1986-90 Menlo position, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.

Stretch Inc., software-configurable processors; wound down in 2014 with its assets sold to Exar. Form D 2010 $57.7M with Hal Calhoun. First listed 2004, so the band rides a filing six years after the entry.

Suno, generative music; Menlo led the Series C in 2025 (firm's own page and its own announcement post) through the dedicated Menlo Inflection Suno Partners vehicles. The $2.45B mark predates the 2025 round and goes to the A/B pass.
Sure, embedded insurance APIs; Menlo partnered at the seed in 2017 (firm's own page).
Swantide, Salesforce automation; Form D 2022 $7.0M with Naomi Ionita.

Sync Research, frame-relay access; NASDAQ IPO 1995, merged into Osicom/Entrada in 1999. Recovered from the LOGO-ONLY row on the 1998 communications page and corroborated by a Menlo fund 13G. Pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.

Syntellect, interactive voice response; merged with Enhanced Systems in 1996 and later folded into Enghouse. A late-1980s Menlo position on the 1998 communications page, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
Synthego, synthetic RNA and CRISPR kits; on the job board and a 2014 listing with no milestone. Entry round not established.
Talari Networks, SD-WAN; Oracle acquired it in 2018. Form D 2010-2012 with Hal Calhoun and Shawn Carolan on the filings.
tCell.io, runtime application self-protection; Rapid7 acquired it in 2018. Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2015 (firm's own page).
Teaching Strategies, early-childhood curriculum and assessment; a REST-only listing with no milestone. Entry round not established.
